overview: A full-stack web-based Automated Attendance & Payroll System. Manage employees, track biometric attendance (simulated), calculate monthly salary with overtime, and handle advance salary requests with admin approval — all in the browser with persistent data.
features: Employee management with CRUD: add, edit, soft-delete, search
Biometric attendance simulation: check-in/check-out by ID scan with time tracking
Manual attendance entry with date, check-in, and check-out times
Automatic overtime calculation (hours beyond 8/day at 1.5x rate)
Monthly salary statement: basic pay, overtime, advance deductions, net salary
Advance salary requests with repayment schedule and admin approval workflow
Role-based access: HR admins manage employees, process payroll, and approve advances
Attendance and employee filters with URL search param persistence
